text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-you'll help me put t'gether an<n>outfit?! You mean
it, City?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
We'll call it your birthday present. So,<n>what style
are you going for?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what style? Um... Golly, I'm not<n>too familiar with
brand names...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No need to overthink it. Just tell me<n>what kind of
vibe you like.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Uh, then... is there an outfit you like<n>wearing the
most?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it's gotta be my Sansa Odori<n>festival robes!
Mama spent all night<n>sew'n it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oopsies! That's not what you meant,<n>is it? Haha...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Traditional clothes, huh... Maybe<n>clothes with
Japanese patterns... or<n>perhaps traditionally dyed
fabrics?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
This'll be tough! But we're definitely<n>making this
happen!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City... Wowzers, you sound like a<n>bon'fide pro!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A pro, huh? Just know I'm doing this<n>for you,
'kay?
